greetingPrompt: I help you build a sourced argumentation matrix. Write to me to get started.
askLanguage: Français ou English ? Choisissez une langue / Pick a language.

intake.title: Case intake
intake.opposingArguments: Arguments already raised by the other side (optional, one per line)
intake.missingIntro: I still need a few details:
intake.complete: Thank you, the case is open. Let's move on to the exhibits.

ask.court: Which court will hear the case?
ask.areaOfLaw: What is the area of law?
ask.stance: What is your client's role (claimant, defendant or other)? Please confirm it.
ask.objective: What outcome is your client seeking?
ask.dateOfFacts: What is the date of the facts (YYYY-MM-DD)?
ask.parties: Who are the parties and what are their roles?
ask.documents: Which exhibits can you send me?

court.cq-small: Cour du Québec, Division des petites créances

stance.invalid: Enter the client's name and, for "Other", describe the role.
stance.suggestion: The documents suggest that {name} is the {role}.
stance.notRight: No, that’s not the right role

upload.title: Documents
upload.prompt: Add the case exhibits. Accepted formats: PDF, DOCX, TXT, or the text selected in the document.
upload.useSelection: Use the selected text in the document
upload.nothingSelected: Nothing is selected in the document.
upload.failed: {name}: {reason}. Please provide another format (text PDF, DOCX or TXT).
upload.transcribing: {name} has no text layer: transcribing it with OCR…
upload.held: Exhibits received: I’ll number them as soon as your client’s role is confirmed.
upload.dropHere: Drop your exhibits here (PDF, DOCX, TXT)
upload.received: Done: {count} exhibit(s) added to the case.
upload.nextAnalyse: Add more, or click “Analyse the exhibits” when you’re ready.
upload.heldReply: I received {count} document(s). I’ll number them as exhibits as soon as your client’s role is confirmed.
upload.noneUsable: I couldn’t read these documents. See the warning below.

facts.title: Facts
facts.intro: Tick the facts to tie together into the argument. The list is in chronological order.
